text: Android: picking an add-dialog suggestion mutates the item before Save/Cancel

Heads up: this reverses a deliberate A8 decision (commit 936e878), which
documented pickSuggestion's immediate setStatus as intentional
"persist-on-action" styling. The reviewer's call (Cancel should undo) is right,
but the fix touches three coupled spots: (a) pickSuggestion -> pure prefill;
(b) save() currently guards setStatus behind `if (state.isEditMode)` precisely
because pick already did it — that guard must change so a picked existing item
also gets status=TODO on Save; (c) update pickSuggestion's doc-comment
(ItemFormViewModel.kt:126). Also ItemFormViewModelTest's "picking a suggestion
sets it todo..." case asserts the mutation via itemsRepo.getById right after
pickSuggestion — that assertion must move to after save().

Done in d87b08b. pickSuggestion -> pure prefill (no DB write, no longer a Job); status applied on Save (the itemId!=null branch sets TODO for a picked item, chosen status for an edit; new items stay created-TODO). Cancel now leaves a picked item untouched. Unit-tested no-mutation-on-pick + todo-on-save; AddItemDialogTest updated. Full debug suite + lintDebug green.
